note: Two tiers were added to every category reaching levels 38 and 50: the catalogue stopped around level 25 while the progression curve now runs to 60, leaving a player past their first month with one item left to want in the whole game.  Room scope (HC-P1-S5): every piece now names the rooms it belongs in, and 43 pieces were added for the rooms that had nothing of their own — the gym had a treadmill and a weight rack against eight slots, the pool and the cinema had nothing at all, and the back of house shared one cleaning trolley.
